convert_linear_to_srgb: convert a linear RGB numpy array to sRGB tone curve using the linear2srgb function
convert_srgb_to_linear: convert an sRGB tone curve numpy array to linear RGB using the srgb2linear function
save_linear_image_as_exr: save a linear RGB numpy array as an uncompressed EXR file using save_linear_as_exr
save_linear_image_as_jpeg: save a linear RGB numpy array as a JPEG with sRGB transfer curve using save_linear_as_jpeg
add_centered_label_to_image: add a centered text label to the top or bottom of an image using add_label_centered
